question: Who is the president of the republic of zambia?
text: **Hakainde Hichilema** is the president of the Republic of Zambia. He was sworn in for his second term on September 1, 2026. ([pbo.parliament.gov.zm](https://pbo.parliament.gov.zm/sites/default/files/images/publication_docs/2027%20Budget%20Speech_Final.pdf?utm_source=openai))
